title: Insight Personalizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners tailor one Challenger insight about legacy system costs for a CFO, a startup CTO, and a healthcare COO by choosing an emphasis and a supporting context, and see the rewritten insight.

learningObjectives: Tailor a Challenger insight for different stakeholders by selecting which aspects to emphasize and which context to provide.

keyQuestions: Tailor a Challenger insight for different stakeholders by selecting which aspects to emphasize and which context to provide.
commonMisconceptions: Personalization is just adding a name.
The same insight works for everyone.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct emphasis and context for all three stakeholders.
Learner can explain why the healthcare COO needs a risk scenario.
